answers.answer: Agreed and propagated. The ~10-week HBM3E observation gap (publication date 2026-07-12 despite price_staleness_days=0) doesn't change my CXMT catalyst's classification (structural threat) or the ~1yr-ahead-of-consensus magnitude, which rests on the risk-production/qualification fact itself, not on pricing.
